purpose: Teach: 智子/秀夫/美香/花園/小人/夫君/姐/追い出し

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の智子さんとお茶されてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer was having tea with her friend Tomoko.
lines.style: Soft, observant tone. Gentle sharing of something noticed. Warm and unhurried, like offering a small detail that made you smile.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お父様のお名前が秀夫さんだって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer mentioned her father's name is Hideo.
lines.style: Quiet, reflective. Passing along something personal that was shared. No judgment, just remembering and telling back.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、ご友人の美香さんと打ち合わせされてたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer was meeting with her friend Mika earlier.
lines.style: Steady, conversational. Offering another small fact observed. The tone of someone who listens and remembers without trying too hard.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、花園を散策してから来店されたって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer came in after taking a walk through the botanical garden.
lines.style: Interested, gently curious. Sharing something that paints a picture. Warm without being intrusive, noticing the details of someone's day.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、漫画の小人キャラに詳しいって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer really knows a lot about dwarf characters in manga.
lines.style: Light acknowledgment with a hint of fondness. Sharing something unexpected about someone. Easy, natural delivery.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、「夫君と一緒に支え合って生きる」って仰ってたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer said something about supporting her husband and being supported by him as they live their life together.
lines.style: Tender, slightly careful with the weight of what's being shared. Speaking someone else's sincere words with respect. Slow enough to land.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、お姉様、つまり姐さんを頼ってらっしゃるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer relies on her older sister.
lines.style: Simple, knowing tone. Stating something true about family bonds. Understands the comfort of that reliance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、退職者の追い出し記念会を企画されてるって、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, your customer is organizing a farewell party for someone who's retiring.
lines.style: Observant and warm. Noting something thoughtful that someone is doing. Slight close-in, like sharing something that matters. Trailing softly.
